problem:
Title: Space of Continuous on Closed Interval Real-Valued Functions with Pointwise Addition and Pointwise Scalar Multiplication forms Vector Space

Let $I := \closedint a b$ be a [[Definition:Closed Real Interval|closed real interval]].

Let $\map C I$ be the [[Definition:Space of Real-Valued Functions Continuous on Closed Interval|space of real-valued functions continuous on $I$]].

Let $\struct {\R, +_\R, \times_\R}$ be the [[Definition:Field of Real Numbers|field of real numbers]].

Let $\paren +$ be the [[Definition:Pointwise Addition of Real-Valued Functions|pointwise addition of real-valued functions]].

Let $\paren {\, \cdot \,}$ be the [[Definition:Pointwise Scalar Multiplication of Real-Valued Functions|pointwise scalar multiplication of real-valued functions]].

Then $\struct {\map C I, +, \, \cdot \,}_\R$ is a [[Definition:Vector Space|vector space]].
